name: faq-create
description: A FAQ creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create and publish a new FAQ under a specified site language and FAQ group, with support for cover image, question, tags, summary, answer, and SEO data.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

faq.description: Required. Complete FAQ payload for a new FAQ.

faqgroup_id.description: Required. FAQ group ID for the new FAQ. First call `faqgroup-read`, then copy one exact `faqgroup_id`.

cover_image.description: Optional. Cover image payload. Maximum size is 500 kB.

name.description: Image file label used only to identify this image inside the payload.

base64.description: Base64 image data with MIME prefix, for example `image/jpeg;base64,...`.

question.description: Required. FAQ question shown to users, up to 100 characters.

tags.description: Required. Provide 1 to 6 unique FAQ keyword tags. Each tag must contain 3 to 50 characters.

summary.description: Required. FAQ summary as plain text, up to 500 characters.

answer.description:
Required. HTML fragment only. Do not include any `

` tag, and prefer `

` to `

`. `` may use a normal URL or `data:image/...;base64,...`. At most 50 `` tags are allowed. Each single `` image must be 500 kB or smaller. Before generating this field, call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and the exact scene value `faq.answer`.

seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for search engines.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact FAQ creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact FAQ payload to be created.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact FAQ payload shown to the user before execution.

url.description: Preview URL for the created FAQ. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

faq.faqgroup_id.description: Select a FAQ group ID from `faqgroup-read` under the same language.
